responsibility: Implements common infrastructure shared across Rust HIR type-checking passes. It provides helpers for detecting unconstrained generic parameters, resolving literal expressions to builtin or inference types, parsing repr attributes into ADT layout options, dispatching to unification, coercion, and cast sites while recording adjustment mappings in TypeCheckContext, and resolving generic parameters and defaults into substitution mappings for later item/type checking.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared helper behavior behind TypeCheckBase, such as literal typing, repr parsing, unconstrained-parameter checks, generic-parameter setup, and the common unify/coercion/cast sites that record adjustments in TypeCheckContext. Unlike rust-hir-type-check-base.h, it contains the reusable typechecking logic itself.
